title: Duty on business insurance phased out (Victoria)
summary: Victoria is abolishing duty on business insurance premiums, cutting the rate by one percentage point a year from 1 July 2024 until it reaches zero on 1 July 2033. It covers classes such as public and product liability, professional indemnity, fire and industrial special risks, and marine and aviation insurance. Duty on home, contents and car insurance stays at 10%.
